title: Fire's story
author: Deborah Namugosa, Beatrice Nabune, Alison Tukei, Rose Sabano
illustrator: Rob Owen, Wiehan de Jager, Amir Bachir António Necas
pages:
Let me tell you my
story.
I start as a small spark.

I run wild when the
wind carries me.

We are good friends,
you and I.
I am part of your family.

But be careful when
you invite me to your
home.
I don't like to be left
alone.
